description: This stacked horizontal bar chart, titled “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision,” compares the composition of two categories—labeled “Standard” on the vertical axis and an unlabeled category on the top bar—by breaking each down into three segments representing “Context” (blue), “Generated Response” (orange), and “Other” (green), as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis represents percentage composition, with values ranging from 0% to 100% and tick marks at regular intervals of 10%. The top bar, corresponding to the unlabeled category, is composed of a blue segment labeled “60.6%,” an orange segment labeled “31.7%,” and a green segment labeled “7.7%,” summing to 100%. The bottom bar, labeled “Standard,” is composed of a blue segment labeled “23.6%,” an orange segment labeled “51.1%,” and a green segment labeled “25.3%,” also summing to 100%. The bars are not sorted and are presented side-by-side vertically, with the “Standard” bar positioned below the unlabeled bar. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the percentage labels on each segment.
